name: Kuramochi Yumi
source:
A married woman.
She has a serious personality and is polite, but she is strict with both those around her and herself.
She is a former beautiful warrior, and she is currently training for emergencies.
Her childhood friend and her husband have taken over her dojo, which has been run by her family for generations.
While running the dojo, she was also looking for candidates for the next generation of beautiful warriors, but she was unable to find any, so she decided to return to active duty and fight.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1254692
